definition: Showing off achievements, belongings or lifestyle, sometimes just for fun.
solution_for_parents: Ask about the joy behind it instead of calling it bragging. Kids often just want recognition.
context_example: Your child posts new shoes: "Just a little flex, Mom."

definition: Feeling embarrassed or secondhand awkward about something corny.
solution_for_parents: Don't take it as disrespect. Ask "What made it awkward for you?" to learn their taste.

definition: Someone they secretly like, not necessarily confessed to.
solution_for_parents: Stay gentle and don't tease in front of others. Telling you is a sign of trust.
context_example: "I have a crush, please don't ask too much."

definition: A warning sign that a person or relationship may be unhealthy.
solution_for_parents: Ask which signs worry them. It is a chance to teach them to protect themselves.
context_example: "Checking my phone all the time is a red flag."

definition: A good, trustworthy sign in a person or relationship.
solution_for_parents: Ask what makes them feel safe, then share your own standards.

definition: Suddenly disappearing and ignoring messages without explanation.
solution_for_parents: If your child was ghosted, be there first. Don't analyze their mistakes yet.

definition: Someone who does too much for a person they like, sometimes losing self-respect.
solution_for_parents: Don't laugh at them. Talk about showing love while keeping boundaries.
context_example: "He's a total simp for the class monitor."

definition: Doing something brilliantly; used as a compliment.
solution_for_parents: It's praise! Answer warmly: "You did great, I'm proud of you."

definition: No lie, I'm telling the truth.
solution_for_parents: Trust their word and ask for details if needed instead of doubting at once.
context_example: "I got a 9 on the test, no cap."

definition: A lie or an exaggeration.
solution_for_parents: If they say someone is "cap", don't judge. Ask what felt untrue.

definition: The feeling, atmosphere or energy of a place or person.
solution_for_parents: Ask "What's the vibe like?" Kids love genuine curiosity.
context_example: "This cafe has such a nice vibe."

definition: Relatable feeling, or simply a current emotion.
solution_for_parents: "Mood" is often how they talk about feelings. Gently ask how today feels.
context_example: Your child sends a sleepy cat meme: "Mood today."

definition: Harmful to one's mental well-being (a person, place or relationship).
solution_for_parents: Ask which behavior bothers them. Don't dismiss their feelings.
context_example: "The class group chat is so toxic."

definition: Manipulating someone into doubting their own memory and feelings.
solution_for_parents: If they say this to you, stay calm and listen to what they feel is being denied.
context_example: "Mom, don't gaslight me, I remember clearly."

definition: Fear of missing out on something fun others are doing.
solution_for_parents: Share a time you felt left out. Agree on screen-time limits together.
context_example: "I have FOMO, everyone went out and I stayed home."

definition: You only live once, so just try it.
solution_for_parents: Don't forbid at once. Ask about the risks and agree on safe limits.
context_example: "Let's go on the road trip, YOLO!"

definition: In real life, not online.
solution_for_parents: Invite them to a real activity together, like cooking or a walk.

definition: The couple you most want together (in shows, stories or idols).
solution_for_parents: Ask why they love this pair. It's how they bond with friends.

definition: To support two people being a couple, real or fictional.
solution_for_parents: Smile along instead of calling it silly. It's a shared joy.

definition: Your favorite member of a group.
solution_for_parents: Ask who their bias is and why. They love telling you.
context_example: "My bias is the one in the middle."

definition: To be an extremely devoted fan of an artist or celebrity.
solution_for_parents: Ask what they love about them. Agree on a reasonable spending limit.

definition: The community of fans of one idol or work.
solution_for_parents: Fandom is where they belong. Ask about their friends there.
context_example: "My fandom is raising money for charity."

definition: Noisy conflict or gossip, usually spread online.
solution_for_parents: Ask if it affects them, and remind them not to attack others.

definition: Waiting for or following exciting news or gossip.
solution_for_parents: Ask what they are waiting for rather than calling it idle curiosity. Join in!

definition: Awesome, lively, giving it all.
solution_for_parents: A fun compliment. Respond with enthusiasm.

definition: So cute or so touching you could faint.
solution_for_parents: An exaggerated way to praise. Just smile.
context_example: "This baby is so cute I'm fainting."

definition: Very cool, tough and unshakable.
solution_for_parents: A compliment. Say "You're really something!" so they feel recognized.

definition: An exclamation of surprise or disbelief.
solution_for_parents: Just an exclamation. Ask what surprised them.
context_example: "Oh my god, I failed the test!"

definition: From "Let's go": let's start, let's move.
solution_for_parents: Share their excitement. It's enthusiasm, not attitude.

definition: Calling for urgent help, imitating SOS, usually joking.
solution_for_parents: Tell joking from real by the tone. When they ask for help, always ask what's wrong.
context_example: "SOS, due tomorrow and I haven't started."

definition: A cute way of saying 'no' (không).
solution_for_parents: Just a way of talking. No need to correct spelling in casual chat.

definition: A partner or someone special, an affectionate name.
solution_for_parents: Take the news gently and ask politely.

definition: A confident, bold person who looks after their style.
solution_for_parents: Usually a compliment. Ask about their personal style.

definition: Charm, the ability to flirt or attract people.
solution_for_parents: Don't be shy about it. Talk about polite, respectful communication.

definition: Suspicious, something feels off (from Among Us).
solution_for_parents: Usually a joke. If it's real, ask why to keep them safe.

definition: Standing by your own opinion without following the crowd.
solution_for_parents: Ask what their view is and don't rush to argue.

definition: From 'win': a victory or something good.
solution_for_parents: Celebrate with them. One letter is still joy.

definition: From 'loss': a failure or something bad.
solution_for_parents: When they say L, comfort first and teach later.

definition: Quietly, somewhat, not obviously.
solution_for_parents: They are sharing something small. Listen closely.

definition: Clearly, very much, not hiding it.
solution_for_parents: They are being direct. Appreciate the honesty.

definition: An exclamation of boredom, surprise or giving up.
solution_for_parents: Not rudeness. Ask calmly: "What happened?"

definition: Best friend.
solution_for_parents: Ask about their best friend in a friendly way, without prying.

definition: A person who follows routine without personal choice (from background game characters).
solution_for_parents: Don't take it as an insult. Ask what they'd like to change.
context_example: "Same commute every day, I feel like an NPC."

definition: A clear positive change in looks or self.
solution_for_parents: Praise the effort. Avoid negative comments about appearance.
context_example: "I've had such a glow up this year."

definition: Feeling like the star of your own story.
solution_for_parents: Encourage confidence, and remind them to care for others too.

definition: Beyond excellent, the very best.
solution_for_parents: High praise. Answer with pride.
context_example: "That presentation was top of the top!"

definition: Relaxed, comfortable, no pressure.
solution_for_parents: Ask how they like to chill. Spend aimless time together.

definition: Thinking too much, worrying too far ahead.
solution_for_parents: Sit beside them, ask "What worries you most?" and write it down together.

definition: Exhaustion from long-term pressure at school or work.
solution_for_parents: Lower expectations for a while and let them rest. If it lasts, consider seeing a professional.

definition: One person doing most of the work for the whole group.
solution_for_parents: Ask how it feels and how to share work more fairly.
context_example: "I carried the group project all week."

definition: Working or playing nonstop, grinding at one thing.
solution_for_parents: Ask what they are grinding. If it's gaming, agree on break times together.

definition: Gradually collecting resources or points in a game; sometimes saving up for a goal.
solution_for_parents: Ask about their goal instead of banning the game.

definition: Away from keyboard or phone for a while.
solution_for_parents: Telling you beforehand is polite. Respect it.

definition: To tease or provoke for laughs or trouble.
solution_for_parents: Separate fun from harassment. Talk about boundaries when joking.

definition: A beginner without experience.
solution_for_parents: Fine as a joke. Remind them not to use it to put others down.
context_example: "You play this like a noob, Mom."

definition: A skilled, expert player.
solution_for_parents: A compliment. Ask them to show you how to play.

definition: Good game, said when a match ends.
solution_for_parents: A sign of good sportsmanship. Praise them.

definition: To make stronger, or to boost something.
solution_for_parents: Just game terms. Ask to understand more.
context_example: "They buffed my character, it's strong now."

definition: To weaken or reduce power.
solution_for_parents: Ask if it feels unfair; there's nothing more to solve.

definition: Slow, choppy, delayed connection.
solution_for_parents: Offer to check the Wi-Fi instead of scolding about gaming.

definition: It's down to lack of skill, not other causes.
solution_for_parents: A joking phrase. Answer with a smile if they use it on you.

definition: Sticks in your head, hard to shake (songs, phrases).
solution_for_parents: Light-hearted. Ask them about the song.

definition: Caring more about online image than real life.
solution_for_parents: Avoid criticism. Share a time you wanted recognition too.
context_example: "She takes photos for the feed all afternoon."

definition: Posting your location or photo on arrival.
solution_for_parents: Agree on safe location sharing together.
context_example: "I checked in at the new cafe."

definition: Likes, comments, shares and replies online.
solution_for_parents: Understand that engagement is how they stay connected with friends.

definition: Spreading fast online.
solution_for_parents: Ask which video, and whether it's true. Teach how to verify news.

definition: A trend many people are following.
solution_for_parents: Film a wholesome trend together, they'll love it.

definition: Videos, photos or posts made to publish.
solution_for_parents: Ask about what they create; don't assume it's wasted time.

definition: Someone who makes online content.
solution_for_parents: Ask about their channel and support their privacy.

definition: Broadcasting live.
solution_for_parents: Agree on safety rules: no address shown, not during study time.

definition: Filming yourself eating a lot on camera.
solution_for_parents: Stay open-minded but remind them about healthy eating.

definition: Soothing sounds that make listeners relaxed or sleepy.
solution_for_parents: Know it is how they relax and respect it.
context_example: "I listen to ASMR to fall asleep."

definition: A funny image or video that spreads online.
solution_for_parents: Look at memes with them. Laughing together builds understanding.

definition: Silly, over-the-top humor, charming or annoying.
solution_for_parents: Ask about their limits. Remind them jokes shouldn't hurt anyone.

definition: Playful, teasing and not serious.
solution_for_parents: Usually no harm meant. Don't assume they're naughty.

definition: Clowning around to make people laugh.
solution_for_parents: Laugh along.

definition: Saying flirty lines to get attention.
solution_for_parents: Don't make a big deal. Talk about respect and consent.
context_example: "He flirts with the girl next door."

definition: A flirty line, or a gesture hinting at feelings.
solution_for_parents: Ask gently and avoid interrogating.

definition: Seen only as a friend, unable to go further.
solution_for_parents: Stay beside them without scolding. The sadness is real.

definition: The getting-to-know-you phase before officially dating.
solution_for_parents: Talk about respect. Don't push for every detail.

definition: A vague relationship that is not clearly anything.
solution_for_parents: Ask what they want and avoid judging.
context_example: "My thing with them is a situationship."

definition: Dropping small bits of attention to keep someone waiting without commitment.
solution_for_parents: Help them name the feeling of being kept hanging and their right to clarity.

definition: Overwhelming someone with affection to control them.
solution_for_parents: Teach them the warning signs and ask how they feel.
context_example: "We just met and it's already love bombing."

definition: Time set aside for yourself.
solution_for_parents: Respect it. They need space to recharge.

definition: Looking after your own body and mind.
solution_for_parents: Encourage it; it is not selfish.

definition: Recovering emotionally after hurt or exhaustion.
solution_for_parents: Ask what they need. If it lasts long, suggest talking to a professional.

definition: Solid, reliable, everything is fine.
solution_for_parents: A mild compliment.

definition: Stylish, cool, strong-minded.
solution_for_parents: You can compliment them when they are confident.

definition: Personal style and confidence.
solution_for_parents: Praise their confidence and fashion sense.

definition: Following whatever trend is hot.
solution_for_parents: Ask why they like it instead of saying they just follow the crowd.

definition: Unlucky, bad luck.
solution_for_parents: Reassure instead of lecturing. They just need understanding.

definition: Light, easy, nothing big.
solution_for_parents: A modest way of speaking, not a sign of disrespect.

definition: A way of dismissing older people as outdated.
solution_for_parents: Don't react angrily. Ask if there's something you don't understand and listen to each other.

definition: A person of the older generation (often implying outdated).
solution_for_parents: Joke back to ease the distance. Share what you learn from them.

definition: A silly nonsense word among Gen Alpha, from comedy videos.
solution_for_parents: Usually just for laughs. Watch the videos together.

definition: An independent person, little influenced by others, often used jokingly.
solution_for_parents: Just a joking compliment. Laugh with them.

definition: A joking way of saying something weird or strange.
solution_for_parents: Don't look for deep meaning. Ask playfully.

definition: An exclamation of surprise, often joking about looks.
solution_for_parents: Remind them not to say it about real people disrespectfully.

definition: A tongue and jaw posture for a sharper face, turned into a trend.
solution_for_parents: Talk about reliable health information.

definition: A person's presence or charisma; there's '+aura' and '-aura'.
solution_for_parents: A wordplay. Ask why they feel they lost aura.

definition: Happily delusional, imagining what you wish for.
solution_for_parents: Accept the joy, gently bring them back to reality when needed.

definition: Okay, deal, you're on.
solution_for_parents: Just a way of saying OK. Don't mistake it for gambling.

definition: Stressing that the matter is settled, end of discussion.
solution_for_parents: They are asserting themselves. Ask for the reason instead of clashing.

definition: Evokes a certain feeling or style.
solution_for_parents: Just a description. Ask what it is 'giving'.

definition: A reminder to go outside and stop staring at screens.
solution_for_parents: Invite them for a walk instead of ordering.

definition: Scrolling endless bad news and unable to stop.
solution_for_parents: Set phone hours together without blaming.

definition: Total time spent looking at screens.
solution_for_parents: Set limits together and set an example.

definition: To stop following someone online.
solution_for_parents: Ask why. Don't force them to follow relatives.

definition: Read your message but didn't reply.
solution_for_parents: They're hurt at being ignored. Comfort them gently.

definition: Quietly viewing someone's profile or page.
solution_for_parents: Talk about privacy and respect.

definition: Revealing a movie or story before others watch it.
solution_for_parents: If they say "no spoilers", respect it.

definition: Teasing, poking fun, or a subtle jab.
solution_for_parents: Ask whether they meant to joke or to say something real.

definition: Exposing someone's wrongdoing online.
solution_for_parents: Talk about consequences and the line between justice and attack.

definition: Publicly boycotting a celebrity for wrong behavior.
solution_for_parents: Ask their view; discuss forgiveness and accountability.

definition: Someone who criticizes or dislikes constantly.
solution_for_parents: If a hater attacks them, put their feelings first.

definition: Someone who dislikes a particular artist or group.
solution_for_parents: Remind them not to attack others.

definition: A loyal long-time fan.
solution_for_parents: Ask about their memories with the idol.
context_example: "I'm a hardcore fan of this group."

definition: Re-verify a piece of information or a statement.
solution_for_parents: Encourage verifying, and model it yourself.

definition: Digging up someone's old posts online.
solution_for_parents: Talk about digital footprints: what is posted can last.

definition: Following drama just for entertainment.
solution_for_parents: No need to forbid. Suggest balancing time.

definition: Deliberately ignoring, acting like you didn't notice.
solution_for_parents: Ask what they want to avoid, especially with friends.
